title: Comprehensive Profiling of Cancer Cells and Their Microenvironment in Advanced NSCLC
summary: Using single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) profiles gene expression pattern of each individual cell to characterize of the entire tumor ecosystem
overall_design: 42 Samples were collected by diagnostic procedures including transcutaneous needle biopsy, bronchoscopy or superficial lymph node biopsy for scRNA_seq
*** Submitter states that raw data are not available for this Series due to patient privacy concerns and human genetic resources policy in China.

title: P1
data_processing: Quality control
scRNA-seq reads were aligned to the GRCh38 genome assembly using STAR version 020201
aligned bam files were dealing with Featurecounts Version 1.6.2 to get UMI counts of each cell
Genome_build: GRCh38
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: expression matrix file using RNA raw count
